derived_series.rates_reason: Measured HOLD. The missing ingredient is exogenous signal-present versus noise-only labels on held-out trials. This derived series has 2921 samples. Event columns on this file were counted and rejected as ground truth: L2_event (634 rows marked 1), is_conjunction (504 rows marked 1), is_opposition (160 rows marked 1). A marked row is not a noise-only twin trial, and this file has no generator, so those flags are not a measured signal-in-noise label. The calibration path fits upper_threshold at tail 0.05 on noise-only scores and scores the held-out half with Wilson intervals. Noise-only trials: 0. Signal-present trials: 0. The threshold was not fit. Wilson intervals were not computed. Seeded shuffles and planted impulses are tagged synthetic_planted and are not written here. No order was sent. The release boundary stays HOLD.
